events.text: Both source and root-import commits are in place (`4ed7310`, `07786bb`). I’m moving through the required verification sequence now: scoped module build, explicit `#print axioms` probe, then the root build, each as its own serialized mutex owner.

data.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
lock=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
source_file=AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationComparison.lean
root_file=AlgebraicJacobian.lean
mkdir -p /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks
if ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
  printf '"'mutex busy: '
  if [ -f \""'$lock/pid" ]; then sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock/pid"; else printf '"'owner unknown\\n'; fi
  exit 75
fi
owner="'$$
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$owner" > "$lock/pid"
cleanup() {
  if [ -f "$lock/pid" ] && [ "$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock/pid")" = "$owner" ]; then
    unlink "$lock/pid"
    rmdir "$lock"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
read -r source_before _ < <(sha256sum "$source_file")
read -r root_before _ < <(sha256sum "$root_file")
head_before=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
printf '"'owner=%s source=%s root=%s head=%s\\n' \""'$owner" "$source_before" "$root_before" "$head_before"
lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationComparison
build_status=$?
read -r source_after _ < <(sha256sum "$source_file")
read -r root_after _ < <(sha256sum "$root_file")
head_after=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
printf '"'build_status=%s source_after=%s root_after=%s head_after=%s\\n' \""'$build_status" "$source_after" "$root_after" "$head_after"
if [ "$source_before" != "$source_after" ] || [ "$root_before" != "$root_after" ] || [ "$head_before" != "$head_after" ]; then
  printf '"'verification inputs changed during build\\n'
  exit 74
fi
exit \""'$build_status"'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
lock=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
probe=Pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationComparisonAxioms.lean
source_file=AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationComparison.lean
mkdir -p /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks
if ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
  printf '"'mutex busy: '
  if [ -f \""'$lock/pid" ]; then sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock/pid"; else printf '"'owner unknown\\n'; fi
  exit 75
fi
owner="'$$
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$owner" > "$lock/pid"
cleanup() {
  if [ -f "$lock/pid" ] && [ "$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock/pid")" = "$owner" ]; then
    unlink "$lock/pid"
    rmdir "$lock"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
read -r probe_before _ < <(sha256sum "$probe")
read -r source_before _ < <(sha256sum "$source_file")
head_before=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
printf '"'owner=%s probe=%s source=%s head=%s\\n' \""'$owner" "$probe_before" "$source_before" "$head_before"
lake env lean "$probe"
probe_status=$?
read -r probe_after _ < <(sha256sum "$probe")
read -r source_after _ < <(sha256sum "$source_file")
head_after=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
printf '"'probe_status=%s probe_after=%s source_after=%s head_after=%s\\n' \""'$probe_status" "$probe_after" "$source_after" "$head_after"
if [ "$probe_before" != "$probe_after" ] || [ "$source_before" != "$source_after" ] || [ "$head_before" != "$head_after" ]; then
  printf '"'verification inputs changed during axioms probe\\n'
  exit 74
fi
exit \""'$probe_status"'
